bootstrap.procedure: replicates drawn from the fitted null (points and calibration counts) before any fit; single and static refit globally (batched least-squares grid, pooled L-BFGS-B); telegraph and tls refit from the replicate's static fit at every RATE_STARTS rate

coprime_swap.pairing: X and Y (and Z) of each delay run as adjacent entries of one PUB's parameter sweep, so both quadratures of a delay share the PUB's shot interleaving and no inter-PUB drift separates them
coprime_swap.purpose: 693 and 819 dt lattices (gcd 63 dt) in X and Y, plus Z after an X preparation (TLS swap), plus the no-herald and post-herald-idle control arms

coprime_swap_long.pairing: X and Y (and Z) of each delay run as adjacent entries of one PUB's parameter sweep, so both quadratures of a delay share the PUB's shot interleaving and no inter-PUB drift separates them
coprime_swap_long.purpose: coprime_swap plus X, Y and Z at 60, 120, 240 and 360 us for the envelope and slow switching

dense.pairing: X and Y (and Z) of each delay run as adjacent entries of one PUB's parameter sweep, so both quadratures of a delay share the PUB's shot interleaving and no inter-PUB drift separates them
dense.purpose: uniform 0.252 us complex Ramsey grid to 35.3 us

run_lattice.pairing: retained: X and Y of a delay in separate PUBs of one job, in an execution order the service does not guarantee
run_lattice.purpose: the retained run's lattice, the reference whose relative aliases tie

discriminators.charge_parity: a near the same value in every repeat (1/2 at equal parity occupation) while df moves with the offset charge n_g; Z after X shows T1 decay without swap
discriminators.static_unexplained: a, df and f1 constant across repeats and no Z swap
discriminators.tls_exchange: g = |df| sqrt(a (1 - a)) constant across repeats while Delta = df (2a - 1) and a wander with the TLS frequency; Z after X shows swap oscillation at Omega = |df| with depth (1 - p) 4 a (1 - a), absent only for a TLS held excited (p = 1)

repeat_plan.homogeneity_test: chi-square of each per-repeat estimate against its inverse-variance mean (3 degrees of freedom for 4 repeats), at the family alpha of the follow-up case
repeat_plan.per_repeat_fit: static, telegraph and tls at the resolved alias; record a, df, f1, g, Delta per repeat
repeat_plan.spacing: at least 60 min apart; the repeats are time-separated. A pair counts as two calibration cycles only when the execution-start calibration each run records (properties at execution) differs in identity and in 143's values; parameter monitoring runs about hourly and recalibrates only on a deviation (docs/notes/ibm_quantum/calibration-jobs.md), so 60 min alone does not guarantee a new calibration

follow_up.selection_rule: cheapest design whose worst alias-pair, tls-versus-static and static-versus-tls expected log-likelihood ratios all reach 50.0
follow_up.status: descriptive design data; live_run and the planner carry no delay-member builder for it

lattice.common_mode: every frequency shifted by n f0 predicts the same counts in every model (exact)
lattice.relative_single_static: df shifted by n f0 predicts the same counts in single and static (exact)
lattice.relative_telegraph_tls: df shifted by n f0 changes the prediction only through the dissipative mixing of the two lines (rate gamma or gamma_tls) and the swap readout

single.description: one frequency with an exponential envelope

static.description: classical two-frequency mixture fixed within each shot

telegraph.description: Kubo-Anderson two-state frequency switching at total rate gamma

tls.description: qubit exchange-coupled to a damped two-level system (Lindblad, 4 x 4 density matrix)

parity_band.status: hypothetical sensitivity study: the grid spans generic fixed-frequency transmon parameters; Heron r2 properties publish no frequency or anharmonicity for 143, so no row describes 143

residue_class.reading: X and Y fix the residue class of df modulo f0, not its sign: the class of -df (the visibility-only twin) refits worse by mirror_delta_nll, while the aliases df + n f0 of either sign tie; every magnitude |df| of the visibility-only fit stays, each with one sign

source.selection: all_zero: shots whose initialization herald reads every pinned qubit 0

status: descriptive: post hoc models of the preregistered sweep, outside its preregistration
tls_population: unidentified: a two-level qubit's Ramsey coherence is independent of the TLS thermal population p (self-check tls); the fits read p = 0, and every follow-up separation that uses the Z swap takes its worst case over POPULATION_GRID
